blocks.en: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors. For 637 Atlantic and eastern North Pacific tropical cyclones from the 2002-2023 hurricane seasons, we analyze the discussion text and its combination with 13 hurricane environmental predictors from SHIPS and ERA5 10-meter wind fields, for forecasting intensity changes at lead times of 24 to 120 hours using three modeling methods. In one approach, an end-to-end deep learning framework for the text shows that the discussions alone offer comparable value for 24-hour intensity forecasts to the SHIPS predictors. Adding discussion information to the SHIPS predictors in an ensemble of five such models reduces the mean absolute error of 24-hour maximum sustained wind forecasts for 2022-2023 cyclones from 9.89 to 8.90 kt, with a confidence interval that excludes zero when whole storms are resampled. The ERA5 wind fields have a minor effect on mean absolute error in wind predictions, and model rankings differ across predicted variables, lead times and model types. We provide prediction intervals for these forecasts, whose coverage falls below the 90% target during rapid intensification. Analysis of the text shows that words related to intensity and intensity change (such as intensify, weaken, eyewall and category) are important for the model predictions. This retrospective study shows the added value of the forecasters' discussions and suggests that multi-modal learning can help understand the predictive contribution of expert human judgment. The reanalysis data differ from real-time analyses, and the discussions are issued at least three hours after the valid time of the other inputs, so these results should not be interpreted operationally.
blocks.zh: 国家飓风中心定期发布"热带气旋讨论",为了解其"热带气旋预报"提供见解. 本研究报告审查了这些讨论对超出一组数字预测器的强度预测的附加价值。 对于从2002-2023年飓风季开始的637个大西洋和北太平洋东部热带气旋,我们分析讨论文本及其与来自SHIPS和ERA5 10米风场的13个飓风环境预测器的组合,用于在24到120小时的准备时间使用三种建模方法预测强度变化. 一种做法是,案文的端到端深度学习框架表明,仅讨论本身就可以对船舶和港口服务处的24小时强度预测提供可比价值。 在由5个这样的模型组成的组合中,将讨论信息添加到SHIPS预测器中,将2022-2023年气旋24小时最大持续风速预报的平均绝对误差从9.89克降至8.90克特,在整场风暴被再现时,置信间隔排除为零. ERA5风场对风能预测中的平均绝对误差影响不大,模型排名因预测变量,周期和模型类型而异. 我们为这些预测提供预测间隔,在快速强化期间,这些预测的覆盖范围低于90%的目标。 对文本的分析表明,与强度和强度变化有关的词语(如加强度,弱化,眼墙和类别)对于模型预测很重要. 这一回顾性研究显示了预测者讨论的附加价值,并表明多模式学习有助于理解专家人类判断的预测性贡献. 重新分析数据不同于实时分析,讨论至少在其他投入有效时间后3小时后发布,因此这些结果不应在操作上解释.

blocks.en: Tropical cyclone (TC) intensity forecasting remains one of the most challenging problems in operational meteorology due to the complex processes across many scales that govern intensification and the nonlinear interactions between storms and their environment. Traditional approaches have provided valuable foundations for intensity prediction. Statistical-dynamical schemes like the Statistical Hurricane Intensity Prediction Scheme (SHIPS) use regression on environmental predictors, including sea surface temperature and wind shear, to forecast intensity change ( DeMaria2005 ) . The GFDL hurricane model has improved track and intensity forecasts through changes to initialization, model physics and ocean coupling ( Bender1993 ; Bender2007 ) . Discussions written by weather forecasters for individual storms provide a complementary source of information, combining observations, model guidance and expert interpretation. Such discussions inform critical decisions and assist threat communication for key National Weather Service partners ( Morss2022a ) .
blocks.zh: 热带气旋强度预报仍然是业务气象学中最具挑战性的问题之一,因为多种规模的复杂过程都制约着强化过程以及风暴及其环境之间的非线性相互作用。 传统方法为强度预测提供了宝贵的基础。 统计飓风强度预测计划等统计动力学计划利用包括海面温度和风切变在内的环境预测器的回归来预测强度变化(德马里亚,2005年)。 GFDL飓风模型通过改变初始化,模型物理和海洋耦合(Bender1993;Bender2007 )改进了跟踪和强度预测. 气象预报员为单个风暴撰写的讨论提供了补充信息来源,结合了观测,模型指导和专家解释. 这些讨论为关键决定提供了依据,并协助国家气象局主要伙伴进行威胁交流(Mors2022a)。

blocks.en: In recent years, machine learning (ML) has offered new ways to extract predictive patterns from large climate datasets. Deep learning models trained on satellite imagery can help locate cyclone centers and classify current intensity ( Do2025-yc ) . Advances in large language models (LLMs) also open the possibility of integrating textual analyses, such as forecast discussions, with numerical data. LLMs can even act as regressors from examples supplied in a prompt, without additional training ( vacareanu2024from ) . Integrating heterogeneous forms of information for a shared prediction task, known as multi-modal learning ( parcalabescu2021 ) , has inspired research on TC intensity forecasting using ML and data fusion. Recent works demonstrate diverse architectural approaches. For example, Boussioux2022 combine features learned from atmospheric reanalysis maps with environmental predictors in gradient-boosted trees, Wang2025 introduce an attention-based model trained on global TC data, Zhang2025 use a diffusion model for multi-modal forecasting, and Gupta2025 study ensemble learning with heterogeneous inputs. We therefore evaluate whether National Hurricane Center (NHC) discussion text provides measurable predictive information when combined with selected tabular predictors and ERA5 wind fields, as summarized in Figure 1 . We call this approach MultiCyclone.
blocks.zh: 近年来,机器学习提供了从大型气候数据集中提取预测模式的新方法。 接受过卫星图像培训的深层学习模型可以帮助确定气旋中心的位置,并对当前强度进行分类(Do2025-yc)。 大语言模型(LLMS)的进步也为将预测性讨论等文字分析与数字数据相结合提供了可能性. LLMS甚至可以充当从一个即时提供的例子中退步者,而无需额外的训练(vacaranu2024 from ). 为共同的预测任务整合多种信息形式,称为多模式学习(parcalabescu2021),激发了利用ML和数据聚变对TC强度预测的研究. 最近的工作显示了不同的建筑方法。 例如,Boussioux2022把从大气再分析地图中吸取的特征与梯度激发树的环境预测器结合起来,Wang2025引进了全球TC数据培训的基于注意力的模型,Zhang2025使用扩散模型进行多模式预测,Gupta2025研究综艺学习采用多种投入. 因此,我们评价国家飓风中心(NHC)的讨论文本是否提供可计量的预测信息,如果与选定的表格预测器和ERA5风场相结合,如图1所汇总. 我们称之为多氯乙烯

blocks.en: MultiCyclone combines tabular meteorological predictors, ERA5 reanalysis winds, and storm-specific NHC discussions to predict changes in TC intensity. We consider leads from 24 to 120 h and focus on the 24 h lead time, for which the retained data include more storms and cases than at longer leads. The experiments assess the information carried by discussions in this retrospective setting. Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 多Cyclone结合了表型气象预测器,ERA5重新分析风力,以及针对风暴的NHC讨论,以预测TC强度的变化. 我们考虑从24小时到120小时的线索,并侧重于24小时的筹备时间,保留的数据包括风暴和病例多于较长的线索。 试验评估了在这种回顾性背景下讨论所收集的信息。 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: • Forecaster discussion text as a predictive modality . We quantify the contribution of storm-specific discussions to retrospective 24 h intensity prediction. The primary neural models using tabular inputs and discussions achieve lower 24 h wind MAE and higher wind R 2 R^{2} than the corresponding models using tabular inputs alone. The size and uncertainty of the gain depend on architecture and evaluation population. • Framework for heterogeneous modalities . We develop a modular framework using pretrained embeddings and encoders trained for each modality to combine tabular predictors, gridded wind fields, and unstructured text, with fixed modality ablations that show when additional sources help or fail to help. • Comparison across forecast leads . We report fixed modality configurations, reference baselines, comparisons across model families, and diagnostics across forecast leads using Atlantic and eastern North Pacific storms. • Analysis of the text signal . We examine the signal in discussion text through integrated gradients attribution, a TF-IDF lexical baseline, and a set of text perturbations. These analyses highlight sensitivity to vocabulary describing intensity and its evolution, but do not confirm the causal contribution of individual information sources and explicit forecaster judgment. • Uncertainty analysis by storm . We evaluate post-hoc interval calibration when forecast errors are correlated within storm tracks. We compare a quantile based on pooled cases with bootstrap calibration that resamples whole storms, Adaptive Conformal Inference with delayed feedback ( gibbs2021adaptive ) , an EnbPI-style proxy ( Xu2021EnbPI ) , and the CLEAR framework ( azizi2025clear ) using the same splits, with whole storms held out for evaluation ( subsection 6.3 ). Coverage is assessed empirically, without a finite-sample guarantee under storm dependence.
blocks.zh: • 预测器讨论案文作为一种预测方式。 我们量化针对具体风暴的讨论对回顾24小时强度预测的贡献。 使用表格式输入和讨论的主要神经模型比仅使用表格式输入的相应模型,实现了较低的24小时风力MAE和更高的风力R2R^{2}. 收益的规模和不确定性取决于建筑和评价人口。 • 各种模式的框架 我们利用为每种模式培训的预先训练的嵌入器和编码器,开发一个模块化框架,将表格预测器、网格风场和无结构文字结合起来,并配有固定模式拼贴,显示额外来源是否帮助。 • 预测线索之间的比较。 我们利用大西洋和东北大西洋风暴报告固定模式配置、参考基线、模型家族之间的比较以及预测线索之间的诊断。 • 分析文本信号。 我们通过综合梯度归属、TF-IDF词汇基线和一组文本扰动来审查讨论文本中的信号。 这些分析突出了描述强度及其演变的词汇的敏感性,但并不确认单个信息来源的因果关系和明确的预测者判断. • 支助 风暴的不确定性分析 当预报错误与风暴轨道相关时,我们评价时间间隔后校准。 我们比较一个基于集合的病例与靴子校准来重新标注整场风暴、适应性正规推论与延迟反馈(gibbs2021adaptive ),一个EnbPI式的代用(Xu2021EnbPI),以及使用相同分数的CLEAR框架(azi2025clear ),整个风暴都保留出来进行评价(6.3分节)。 对覆盖范围进行实证评估,在风暴依赖下没有有限的抽样保障。

blocks.en: The work most relevant to this study falls into four areas, covering established intensity forecasting, machine learning with numerical and image inputs, meteorological text models, and uncertainty quantification. We review these areas to identify what storm-specific forecast discussions may add to the numerical inputs used here.
blocks.zh: 与这项研究最有关的工作分为四个领域,包括既定的强度预报、用数字和图像输入的机器学习、气象文本模型和不确定性量化。 我们审查这些领域,以确定针对具体风暴的预报讨论可能增加这里使用的数字投入。

blocks.en: Early intensity forecasting relied on statistical and statistical-dynamical approaches. For example, SHIPS employs multiple regression with environmental predictors such as sea surface temperature, vertical wind shear, and storm structure parameters to forecast intensity changes ( DeMaria2005 ) . Successive versions incorporating new predictors and updated datasets showed significant skill out to 72 hours in the Atlantic compared to climatology and persistence baselines, while dynamical forecast systems based on numerical weather prediction models have evolved substantially over recent decades. The GFDL hurricane model lineage, beginning with pure atmospheric dynamical cores and progressing through ocean coupling, has demonstrated the value of improved physics parameterizations and increased resolution ( Bender1993 ; Bender2007 ) . Modern operational systems like HWRF and HAFS continue this evolution, incorporating advanced vortex initialization schemes and high-resolution nested grids. Together, these traditional methods provide essential baselines and remain operationally important, but the substantial cost of running these models motivates exploration of data-driven models that can more flexibly incorporate diverse observations, akin to the use of data assimilation in dynamical forecast systems.
blocks.zh: 早期强度预测依赖于统计和统计动态方法。 例如,SHIPS利用海面温度、垂直风切变和风暴结构参数等环境预测器进行多重回归,以预测强度变化(DeMaria 2005 ) 。 与气候学和持久性基线相比,纳入新的预测器和最新数据集的连续版本显示,大西洋有72小时的出色技能,而基于数值天气预测模型的动态预报系统在近几十年中已发生了重大变化。 GFDL飓风模型分界线,从纯大气动态核心开始,通过海洋耦合取得进展,证明了改进物理参数化和提高分辨率的价值(Bender1993;Bender2007)。 HWRF和HAFS等现代操作系统继续这种演变,包括先进的涡旋初始化计划和高分辨率的巢网. 这些传统方法共同提供了基本基线,在业务上仍然很重要,但运行这些模型的巨额费用促使人们探索数据驱动的模型,这些模型可以更加灵活地纳入各种观测,类似于在动态预测系统中使用数据同化。

blocks.en: Machine learning studies differ in whether they use a single data source or combine complementary modalities. The distinction matters here because our comparisons isolate the contribution of discussion text within a shared evaluation design.
blocks.zh: 机器学习研究在是使用单一数据源还是结合互补模式方面有所不同. 这里的区别很重要,因为我们的比较将讨论文本在共同评价设计中的贡献隔离开来。

blocks.en: Machine learning approaches are applied to TC forecasting using tabular or image data. Gradient boosting machines (e.g., XGBoost) trained on environmental variables can capture nonlinear relationships and reduce intensity forecast errors in retrospective tests ( Jin2019 ) . Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) trained directly on satellite, infrared or microwave images of cyclones have achieved intensity estimates with error comparable to or better than traditional methods ( Combinido2018 ; Chen2019 ) . Do2025-yc use geostationary satellite images to jointly locate cyclone centers and classify current intensity. Their task concerns storm monitoring. A separate CNN approach uses reanalysis fields for intensity forecasting ( Xu2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 机器学习方法用于使用表格或图像数据的TC预测. 受环境变量训练的渐变增压机(如XGBooost)可以捕捉非线性关系,减少回溯性测试(Jin2019)中的强度预报错误. 直接接受卫星、红外或微波气旋图像培训的革命神经网络实现了强度估计,其误差与传统方法相当或更好(Compido2018;Chen2019)。 Do2025-yc使用地球静止卫星图像共同定位气旋中心,并对气流强度进行分类. 他们的任务是监测风暴。 独立的CNN方法使用再分析场进行强度预报(Xu2022).

blocks.en: Recent TC studies combine different numerical or spatial inputs. Gupta2025 study ensembles with heterogeneous datasets, while Zhang2025 introduce a multi-modal diffusion model. HurriCast ( Boussioux2022 ) encodes atmospheric reanalysis maps and combines the learned representation with tabular predictors in a gradient-boosted tree. These studies motivate testing whether a separately produced source of information, the NHC discussion, adds value to a numerical model.
blocks.zh: 最近进行的技术合作研究结合了不同的数字或空间投入。 Gupta2025 研究群集,具有多样的数据集,而Zhang2025则引入了多模式传播模型. HurriCast (Boussioux2022) 编码大气再分析地图,并将所学的表示法和表格预测器结合到梯度激发树上. 这些研究激发了对单独产生的信息来源(NHC讨论)是否为数字模型增值的测试。

blocks.en: Other models combine images and environmental data directly. MSCAR uses causal autoregressive attention to forecast intensity from satellite and reanalysis inputs ( Wang2025 ) . TropiCycloneNet introduces a multi-modal dataset and a generative forecast model that combines images with environmental and temporal features ( Huang2025 ) . TCP-Diffusion instead predicts cyclone-associated rainfall from past precipitation and environmental fields ( Huang2025tcpdiffusion ) . MMSTN jointly forecasts track and intensity ( Huang2022MMSTN ) , whereas MT-GN estimates current intensity through classification and regression from satellite imagery ( Zhao2024MTGN ) . The hybrid model of You2025 combines rainfall images with SHIPS predictors for intensity forecasting.
blocks.zh: 其他模型直接结合图像和环境数据. MSCAR对来自卫星的预测强度采用因果自递式注意,并重新分析输入(Wang2025 ). 特罗皮西克隆 Net引入了多模式数据集和基因预测模型,将图像与环境和时间特征相结合(黄2025 ). TCP-Diffusion则预测过去降水量和环境田地(Huang2025tcpdifusion)产生的与气旋有关的降雨量. MMSTN联合预测轨迹和强度(黄2022MMSTN),而MT-GN则通过卫星图像的分类和回归(Zhao2024MTGN)估算当前强度. You2025的混合模型将降雨图像与SHIPS预测器结合用于强度预测.

blocks.en: While most forecasting models focus on numerical or image data, there is increasing exploration of textual information in weather prediction. This includes not only numerical weather bulletins and structured meteorological text, but also expert discussions, news, and public reports. Text enters weather research as a benchmark target, a source of predictive features, or a direct input to a language model. Our focus is the information carried by forecasters’ storm-specific prose.
blocks.zh: 虽然大多数预测模型都注重数字或图像数据,但天气预测中文本信息的探索却越来越多. 这不仅包括数字气象公报和结构化气象文本,还包括专家讨论、新闻和公开报道。 文本作为基准目标,预测特征来源,或直接输入语言模型进入天气研究. 我们的焦点是预测者针对风暴的传言所携带的信息。

blocks.en: Text often enters indirectly, as a benchmark target paired with weather data. Ma2024WeatherQA pair plots of mesoscale analyses, surface observations and radar reflectivity with Storm Prediction Center discussions, and document limitations of the tested vision-language models through benchmark tasks and expert review. shinde2026wxc present WxC-Bench, a multi-modal benchmark spanning six downstream tasks including both TC monitoring and natural language forecast generation from NOAA Storm Prediction Center reports. Chen2025ClimateIQA construct ClimateIQA, a meteorological visual question answering dataset comprising 762,120 instruction samples paired with reanalysis-derived heatmaps for extreme weather anomaly analysis. Similarly, CLLMate ( Li2025CLLMate ) aligns environmental news articles with reanalysis data and has been used to evaluate 32 multi-modal LLMs on weather and climate event forecasting, revealing both strengths and persistent gaps.
blocks.zh: 文本经常间接输入,作为基准目标与天气数据对齐. 马2024 天气 与风暴预测中心讨论的 " QA " 组合的中尺度分析、表面观测和雷达反射率,以及通过基准任务和专家审查对已测试的视觉语言模型的文件限制。 shinde2026wxc提供WxC-Bench,这是一个跨6个下游任务的多式联运基准,包括TC监测和从NOAA暴风雨预测中心报告生成自然语言预测. Chen2025ClimateIQA构造ClimateIQA,是一个气象视觉问题回答数据集,由762,120个指令样本组成,配对为极端天气异常分析的再分析产生的热图. 同样,CLLMate(Li2025CLLMate)将环境新闻文章与重新分析数据结合起来,并被用于评价32个气象和气候事件预报的多模式LLMs,揭示了优势和持续的差距.

blocks.en: Text is also used directly in some weather-related research tasks. Aquilon ( Varambally2025Aquilon ) combines language queries with encoded weather fields to study multi-modal weather reasoning. Knowledge-guided prompt learning has also been studied for TC intensity estimation ( Li2025KGPL ) . Natural language processing has also been used to extract structured information from weather text. For example, Lai2022NLPFloods geocode historical storms, floods, and adaptation measures from newspaper reports. However, these tasks differ substantially from the focus of this study, which uses multi-modal learning to extract potential human insights from NHC forecaster discussions.
blocks.zh: 文本也直接用于一些与天气有关的研究任务. Aquilon (Varambally2025 Aquilon) 将语言查询与编码的天气领域结合起来,研究多模式天气推理. 还研究了以知识为指南的快速学习,以进行TC强度估计(Li2025KGPL)。 自然语言处理也被用于从天气文本中提取结构化信息. 例如,莱2022NLP 洪水 地质代码历史风暴 洪水 以及报纸报道的适应措施 然而,这些任务与本研究的重点大不相同,该研究利用多种模式的学习从NHC预测器讨论中吸取潜在的人类见解。

blocks.en: Recent studies have demonstrated that LLMs can serve as effective regressors through in-context learning, eliminating the need for task-specific fine-tuning. In-context learning for numeric prediction is when pretrained LLMs are prompted with examples to regress outputs. These approaches view the LLM itself as a text-to-text regression engine ( Aliakbar2025 ) . vacareanu2024from show that LLMs can equal or outperform traditional regression models on various prediction tasks when provided with appropriate in-context examples. tang2025llmregressors study LLM embeddings as features for regression, finding that larger models are not always better. The OmniPred framework extends this concept ( Song2024OmniPred ) , training language models as universal regressors capable of precise numerical prediction across diverse domains using textual representations of mathematical parameters. A known limitation of LLM regressors is that discrete number tokenization and cross entropy over tokens do not directly encode numerical distance. Continuous numerical representations ( Golkar2024xVa ) and losses that account for numerical distance ( Zausinger2025NTL ) address these limitations, and therefore performance depends on the model, representation and task.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究表明,有限责任公司通过内在文字学习可以起到有效的退步者的作用,从而不再需要针对具体任务的微调。 数字预测的内文学习是预先训练的LLMs被用例来退缩输出. 这些方法将LLM本身视为文本对文本回归引擎(Aliakbar2025). vacaranu2024从显示LLMs在提供合适的文本实例时,可以在各种预测任务上等于或超过传统回归模型. tang2025llmressers研究LLM嵌入作为回归的特征,发现较大的模型并不总是更好的. OmniPred框架扩展了这一概念(Song2024OmniPred ),将语言模型培训为通用的递归器,能够使用数学参数的文字表达法在不同的领域进行精确的数值预测. LLM递归器的一个已知限制是,离散数符号化和对符号的交叉式不直接编码数字距离. 连续数字表示(Golkar2024xVa)和计算数字距离的损失(Zausinger2025NTL)解决了这些局限性,因此性能取决于模型,表示和任务.

blocks.en: We review interpretation methods because a central question here is which parts of a discussion the text models respond to. Interpreting which input features drive predictions in transformer-based models remains an active research challenge, with methods broadly falling into three categories: attention-based, gradient-based, and perturbation-based approaches. Attention weights are often used to inspect which tokens a model attends to. Whether they provide a faithful explanation depends on the question being asked and on checks that connect the weights to model behavior ( Wiegreffe2019Attention ; Serrano2019Attention ; Bastings2020Elephant ) . Integrated gradients ( Sundararajan2017IG ) accumulate gradients along a path from a baseline to the input. The method was developed to satisfy sensitivity and implementation invariance, and its attributions sum to the output change from that baseline. Perturbation-based approaches measure how the output changes when parts of the input are masked or removed. A complementary line of work, mechanistic interpretability, aims to reverse-engineer the internal computations of transformer models by identifying interpretable circuits, features in residual streams, and neuron-level roles ( Rai2024MechInterp ) . While these techniques offer deeper insight into how models process information internally, they remain nascent for domain-specific regression tasks such as meteorological prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们审查解释方法,因为这里的一个核心问题是,文本模式对讨论的哪一部分作出反应。 解释哪些输入特性驱动变压器模型中的预测仍然是一个积极的研究挑战,方法大致可分为三类:基于注意力的方法、基于梯度的方法和基于扰动的方法。 注意权重经常用来检查一个模型要注意的标志。 它们是否提供忠实的解释取决于被问到的问题和将权重与模型行为联系起来的检查(Wiegreffe2019 Attenty ;Serrano2019 Attenty ; Bastings2020Elephant ). 集成梯度(Sundarajan 2017IG)沿着从基线到输入的路径积累梯度. 制定这一方法是为了满足敏感性和执行上的偏差,其归属与产出变化的总和来自这一基线。 基于扰动的方法衡量部分输入被遮掩或移除时输出的变化. 一个互补的工作线——机械可解释性,旨在通过识别可解释的电路,剩余流中的特征,以及神经元级角色(Rai2024Mech Interp )来逆向改造变压器模型的内部计算. 虽然这些技术为模型如何内部处理信息提供了更深入的洞察力,但对于气象预测等特定域回归任务来说,它们仍然是新生的.

blocks.en: Intensity forecasts also require an account of predictive uncertainty. We distinguish general interval methods from approaches evaluated specifically for tropical cyclones.
blocks.zh: 强度预测还需要预测不确定性。 我们把一般间隔方法与专门评价热带气旋的方法区分开来。

blocks.en: Split conformal prediction provides marginal coverage under exchangeability of calibration and test scores ( vovk2005algorithmic ) . For models with several input types, azizi2026modalitycalibration studies calibration based on disagreement among modality predictors or on which inputs are available. This is relevant when discussions are missing, although its exchangeability assumptions do not directly cover dependent cases within storms. Ensemble Batch Prediction Intervals (EnbPI) use bootstrap ensemble residuals to form sequential intervals under assumptions on the time series error process ( Xu2021EnbPI ) . Those results do not directly apply to our residual proxy based on a fixed ensemble. Functional Generative Networks use learned model perturbations to generate joint ensemble weather forecasts while training against marginal continuous ranked probability scores ( Alet2025FGN ) . CLEAR ( azizi2025clear ) calibrates regression intervals that combine aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, and azizi2026matchabilityllms applies a related separation to open-ended answers of language models, with conformal sets calibrated for groups of questions identified before generation. These methods address different prediction and dependence settings.
blocks.zh: 在可交换的校准和测试分数(vovk2005algorithmic ) 下,分裂向导预测提供了边际覆盖. 对于有几种输入类型的模型,azizi2026模式校正研究基于模式预测器之间的分歧或可用投入的校正. 在讨论缺失时,这一点是相关的,尽管其可交换性假设并不直接涵盖风暴内部的依赖性病例. EnbPI)在时间序列误差过程(Xu2021 EnbPI )的假设下,使用靴纹共聚物残基形成顺序间隔. 这些结果并不直接适用于我们基于固定组合的剩余代理人。 功能基因网络利用学习到的模型扰动生成联合综艺天气预报,同时针对边际连续排名概率分数(Alet2025FGN)进行训练. CLEAR(azi2025 clear)校准回归间隔,将习性不确定性和感知不确定性结合起来,azi2026可匹配性链对语言模型的开放式解答进行相关分离,对世代前确定的问题组进行配位校准. 这些方法处理不同的预测和依赖性设置.
2.4.2 技术合作预测的不确定性量化

blocks.en: For TC uncertainty quantification, researchers have studied dynamical ensembles, neural distribution models, and conformal methods. The reliability of dynamical ensemble guidance varies by case and verification setting ( bachmann2021validation ) . MTCIE predicts both a mean and a standard deviation for intensity from satellite imagery ( Song2024MTCIE ) , while fernandez2025predicting estimate uncertainty in track forecasts with a neural network. Conformal methods have been applied to TC track ( Meng2024 ) and intensity ( Chen2025 ) . Dependence within storms and shifts between seasons make the exchangeability required for split-conformal coverage uncertain here, which motivates the empirical storm-level analysis in Section 6.3 .
blocks.zh: 就TC不确定性量化而言,研究人员研究了动态集合,神经分布模型,以及整齐方法. 动态共聚制导的可靠性因大小写和校验设置(bachmann2021validation )而异. MTCIE对来自卫星图像(Song2024MTCIE)的强度进行平均偏差和标准偏差预测,而Fernandez2025则用神经网络预测轨道预报的不确定性。 TC轨道(Meng2024)和强度(Chen2025)采用了交配方法. 风暴内部的依赖性以及不同季节之间的变化,使分层形式覆盖所需的可交换性在此不确定,这推动了第6.3节中的经验性风暴级分析.

blocks.en: Our regional dataset uses TCBench storm identifiers and forecast structure ( gomez2024tcbench ) , with the 13 selected predictors and initial intensity read from the SHIPS developmental data at the initial time. These data are compiled after each season from the NHC best track and model analyses. We add ERA5 reanalysis winds and NHC discussions for this study. The discussions are not part of the cited TCBench release. The dataset covers the Atlantic and eastern North Pacific basins from 2002 to 2023. It contains 637 storms (282 Atlantic and 355 eastern North Pacific) and 13,885 cases at 6 h intervals, one per storm and synoptic time. The selected SHIPS predictors and ERA5 wind frames cover all these storms. Section 3.2 describes how discussions are matched to cases and how many cases have a match.
blocks.zh: 我们的区域数据集使用TCBench风暴识别符和预报结构(gomez2024tcbench),最初从SPIS开发数据中读取了13个选定的预测器和初始强度. 这些数据是在每一季之后从NHC最佳轨迹和模型分析中汇编而成的. 我们为这项研究增加了ERA5重新分析风和NHC的讨论. 讨论不属于引用的TCBench释放的一部分. 该数据集涵盖2002年至2023年大西洋和北太平洋东部盆地. 它包含637场风暴(大西洋282场,北太平洋东部355场)和13,885个病例,间隔6小时,每场风暴和综合时间各1场. 选定的SHIPS预测器和ERA5风框覆盖了所有这些风暴. 第3.2节描述了讨论如何与案件相符以及有多少案件是匹配的。

blocks.en: The SHIPS dataset provides 13 meteorological variables derived for each case and summarized in Table 2 . These predictors are grouped into four categories, comprising storm characteristics (e.g., VMAX, MSLP), environmental fields (e.g., CSST, Z850), thermodynamic variables (e.g., EPOS, RHMD), and dynamic variables (e.g., D200, SHGC). Together, these 13 predictors capture both the internal state of the storm and the environmental conditions influencing its intensity evolution. The pairwise Pearson correlations among these variables are shown in subsubsection C.1.1 ( Figure 11 ). As expected, V max V_{\max} and MSLP are strongly anti-correlated, while most environmental predictors are only weakly correlated with one another.
blocks.zh: SPIPS数据集提供13个气象变量,每个案例都得出,汇总于表2。 这些预测器分为四类,包括风暴特征(如VMAX,MSLP),环境领域(如CSST,Z850),热力学变量(如EPOS,RHMD)和动态变量(如D200,SHGC). 这13个预测器共同捕捉风暴的内部状态以及影响其强度演化的环境条件. C.1.1小节(图11)显示了这些变量之间的双向皮尔逊相关性。 正如预期的那样,V max V_{\max}和 MSLP 具有强烈的抗腐蚀性,而大多数环境预测器只是彼此之间微弱的关联.

blocks.en: We use ERA5 reanalysis data ( era5_2020 ) at 0.25° × \times 0.25° resolution, extracting a 41 × \times 41 grid-point box (about 10° × \times 10°) centered on each storm location. The image input contains the u u and v v components of the 10 m wind ( u 10 u_{10} , v 10 v_{10} ). These two fields retain wind direction and speed within the chosen spatial crop. subsection C.3 gives the formulas that link these components to wind speed and direction. We use only these two 10 m wind components and omit potentially useful fields (e.g., humidity, temperature, and upper-level winds) to avoid redundancy with the SHIPS predictors. The data pipeline handles the ERA5 variable names used before 2022 (10u, 10v) and from 2022 onward (u10, v10). Figure 2 summarizes the storm-centered wind magnitude in the training data. ERA5 is produced retrospectively through atmospheric modeling and data assimilation, so these fields should not be read as real-time analysis inputs.

blocks.en: The NHC publishes routine Tropical Weather Discussions for the Atlantic basin (TWDAT, Figure 3 ) and Tropical Cyclone Discussions for individual storms after they form ( Figure 4 ). Early experiments with TWDAT were not promising, so we used the storm-specific discussions instead, without developing a systematic TWDAT ablation. Storm-specific discussions contain observations, guidance summaries, intensity forecasts, and forecaster interpretations. Figure 4 shows one explicit expression of judgment, but our experiments do not isolate the value of such statements. The matching rule is described below, and subsection J.2 examines sensitivity to discussion availability.

blocks.en: Since different modalities are recorded at different times, we specify their timing explicitly. For each case at synoptic time t t , the matching pipeline first searches for storm-specific discussions whose issue times lie within 1 h of t + 6 t{+}6 h. Issue times are read from the header printed in each discussion. Routine discussions for synoptic time t t are issued near t + 3 t{+}3 h, so this window can contain only special discussions. The pipeline prefers a discussion later than t + 6 t{+}6 h within this window and otherwise takes the closest one. If this search has no candidate, it chooses the closest discussion in the archive, taking the earlier one when two are equally close. Most matches arise from this step and are routine discussions issued near t + 3 t{+}3 h. The pipeline then discards selections outside [ t , t + 7 ​ h ] [t,t{+}7\,\mathrm{h}] , without trying another candidate. Consequently, a case can remain unmatched even when another discussion would satisfy the final time window. This matching is held fixed across the model comparisons. In the matched data, 98 % 98\% of issue times are exactly t + 3 t{+}3 h and all offsets lie between t + 3 t{+}3 h and t + 7 t{+}7 h. The matches later than t + 3 t{+}3 h are special discussions. The discussion therefore has a later information set than the time- t t numerical inputs. This is a retrospective comparison, not an operational forecast using the same information at issue time ( subsection 7.5 ). This matching succeeds for 12,704 cases, or 91.5% of the dataset. Each of the 637 storms is matched to at least one discussion, because storms without any match were removed when the dataset was built. That step used the earlier file-name times and left out 56 Atlantic storms (1,176 training and validation cases, none in the test seasons), most of whose cases the printed issue times would match. Coverage is uneven across cases within storms. 308 storms have a matched discussion for every one of their 6,303 cases. The remaining 329 storms span 7,582 cases, of which 6,401 are matched and 1,181 are not. An unmatched case means that no discussion was matched in the collected archive under this rule, not necessarily that no discussion was issued. For fused models, an unmatched discussion is represented by a zero text embedding during training and inference. The neural discussion-only model omits unmatched rows, while the hybrid and temporal text-only regressors keep them with a zero vector. We therefore distinguish the full fused-model population from the matched-discussion population when comparing models, and assess the missingness channel separately.
blocks.zh: 由于不同方式在不同的时间都有记录,因此我们明确说明它们的时间。 对于每个案例,在T t 时,匹配的管道首先搜索针对风暴的讨论,其议题时间在t + 6 t → 6 h 以内。 发行时间从每次讨论所印头读取. 用于Synoptic时间 t t的例行讨论在 t + 3 t{+}3 h 附近发布,因此这个窗口只能包含特殊的讨论. 管道宁可在此窗口内讨论时间晚于 t + 6 t → 6 h,否则最接近。 如果这次搜索没有候选,它会选择档案中最接近的讨论,当两个同样接近时,它会选择较早的讨论. 大部分的匹配来自这一步骤,也是在 t + 3 t{+}3 h 附近发布的例行讨论. 输油管然后丢弃在 [t, t + 7h] [t, t{+}7\,\mathrm{h}] 之外的选择,而不尝试另一个候选人. 因此,即使另一次讨论能满足最后时限,案件仍无法比拟。 这种匹配在模型比较中被固定。 在匹配的数据中,98%的98%的发行时间为 t + 3 t → 3 h,所有抵消时间都在 t + 3 t → 3 h 和 t + 7 t → 7 h之间. 比赛时间晚于t+3 t{+}3 h是特别讨论. 因此,讨论的信息集比时间T数字输入要晚。 这是一种回顾性比较,不是在问题时间使用相同信息的业务预测(7.5分节)。 此匹配成功12,704个案例, 占数据集的91.5% 。 637场风暴中的每一场都至少匹配一次讨论,因为没有匹配的风暴在数据集建成时被移除. 该步骤使用了较早的档案名称时间,并遗漏了56个大西洋风暴(1 176个培训和鉴定案例,在试验季没有),其大多数案例的印刷发行时间将吻合。 风暴期间的覆盖率参差不齐。 308场风暴的6 303个病例都有相应的讨论。 其余329场风暴横跨7,582个病例,其中6,401个对应,1,181个没有. 一个无法匹配的案件意味着,根据这一规则收集的档案中没有相应的讨论,并不一定没有发表任何讨论。 对于已引信的模型,在培训和推论期间嵌入的零文本代表了一种无与伦比的讨论。 神经讨论-只使用模型省略了未匹配的行,而混合式和时间式文本只使用递归器则保留了零向量. 因此,我们在比较模型时,将完整的引信模型人群与匹配讨论人群区分开来,并分别评估缺失通道.

blocks.en: We remove the terminal FORECAST POSITIONS AND MAX WINDS section from storm-specific discussions. This excludes the structured official forecast table, except in two training discussions ( Appendix A ), but the remaining narrative may still contain numerical intensities and forecasts. Table removal alone does not establish the absence of information leakage. The end-to-end neural model loader trims the bulletin header to the first datetime line, normalizes whitespace, converts text to lowercase, and tokenizes it with the RoBERTa tokenizer. We retain up to the first 510 content tokens of each cleaned discussion, plus two special tokens. An exploratory inference check using length-weighted averaging of embeddings from chunks covering the full discussion showed no clear improvement. The hybrid and temporal pipelines use the Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B sentence encoder with its own text-cleaning procedure and the same forecast-section cutoff ( subsection 4.2 , subsection 4.4 ). Both paths use the bounded discussion matching described above.
blocks.zh: 我们从针对具体风暴的讨论中删除了终端位置和MAX WINDS部分。 这不包括结构化的官方预测表,但两次培训讨论除外(附录A),但其余的叙述可能仍然包含数字强度和预测。 单靠表格清除并不能证明没有信息泄漏。 端到端的神经模型加载器将公告头剪切到第一个日期线,使白空间正常化,将文本转换为小写,并用RoBERTa的标致器进行符号化. 我们保留了每次清理讨论的前510个内容符号,加上两个特别符号. 采用长加权平均嵌入量进行探索性推论检查,以涵盖全面讨论,没有明显改进。 混合管和时间管采用Qune3-Embedding-0.6B句式编码器,并采用自己的文本清理程序和相同的预报节断(第4.2分节,第4.4分节). 两条路径都使用上述限定的讨论匹配.

blocks.en: Numerical tabular predictors are standardized using feature statistics from the training set, with the family-specific missing-value handling described in Appendix C . ERA5 images are normalized independently per channel ( u 10 u_{10} , v 10 v_{10} ), using the means and standard deviations of nonzero frames from training storms. Frames that are entirely zero remain zero. Validation and test inputs reuse these statistics. The neural models standardize each intensity-change target using statistics from the training set for the multi-output MSE loss, and predictions are transformed back to knots or hPa for evaluation. The hybrid XGBoost and Ridge regressors fit the intensity-change targets directly in physical units. For fixed predictions, inversion of a common affine target transformation leaves target-specific R 2 R^{2} unchanged. Scaling targets during neural training nevertheless changes the relative weighting of the two losses.
blocks.zh: 数字表型预测器采用培训组的特征统计实现标准化,附录C介绍了针对家庭的缺失值处理。 ERA5图像每个信道(u 10 u_{10},v 10 v_{10})独立正常化,使用非零帧与训练风暴的能量和标准偏差. 完全为零的框架仍然是零。 验证和测试投入再利用这些统计数据。 神经模型利用多输出的MSE损失培训中的统计数据,使每个强度变化目标标准化,预测结果被转换回结或hPa进行评价. 混合式XGBoost和Ridge递减器直接在物理单元中符合强度变化目标. 对于固定的预测,一个常见的亲缘目标转换的倒置会留下特定目标R 2 R^{2}不变. 然而,在神经训练期间扩大目标会改变这两个损失的相对权重。

blocks.en: This section describes our approach to multi-modal tropical cyclone intensity prediction. We begin by formalizing the prediction task, then present three complementary modeling frameworks. These comprise a hybrid architecture combining deep learning encoders with gradient boosting, an end-to-end neural network with learnable fusion, and a temporal extension that models storm evolution over consecutive timesteps. We conclude with training strategies common to all approaches.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们对多模式热带气旋强度预测的方法。 我们首先正式确定预测任务,然后提出三个互补的模型框架。 其中包括一个混合结构,将深层学习编码器与梯度增殖相结合,一个端到端神经网络与可学习的聚变,以及一个时间延伸,将风暴演化模拟于连续的时间步. 最后,我们提出了所有办法的共同培训战略。

blocks.en: For each case at synoptic time t t , we use the available tabular ( T ), image ( I ) and discussion text ( D ) features to predict the change in storm intensity after h h hours, where h ∈ { 24 , 48 , 72 , 96 , 120 } h\in\{24,48,72,96,120\} and cases occur at 6 h intervals. For the full multi-modal ablation we evaluate all uni-modal (T, I, D), bi-modal (T+I, T+D, I+D), and tri-modal (T+I+D) combinations. The prediction targets are Δ ​ V max , h ​ ( t ) = V max ​ ( t + h ) − V max ​ ( t ) , Δ ​ MSLP h ​ ( t ) = MSLP ⁡ ( t + h ) − MSLP ⁡ ( t ) , \Delta V_{\max,h}(t)=V_{\max}(t+h)-V_{\max}(t),\qquad\Delta\mathrm{MSLP}_{h}(t)=\mathrm{MSLP}(t+h)-\mathrm{MSLP}(t), Here V max V_{\max} is maximum sustained wind and MSLP is minimum sea-level pressure. Models are trained and scored on these changes. Absolute future intensity is reconstructed by adding the predicted change to the dataset intensity at time t t . Models containing tabular inputs also receive V max ​ ( t ) V_{\max}(t) and MSLP ⁡ ( t ) \mathrm{MSLP}(t) among their numerical predictors. We emphasize 24 h results because longer leads have fewer valid future intensities. A forecast initialized when the discussion was issued would require a new timing and verification protocol.

blocks.en: Discussion text, reanalysis fields, and tabular predictors are not jointly available for every case. The hybrid approach in subsection 4.2 trains or supplies separate encoders, then fits a regressor to their fixed-length outputs. Because the encoders are fixed, each combination of inputs only requires refitting the regressor. Raw XGBoost feature importance scores over 13 tabular variables and much larger image and text embedding blocks are not comparable measures of modality contribution. Correlated predictors can also distort feature importance ( Nicodemus2010 ) . We therefore assess added predictive value by fitting the model with and without a modality and comparing errors on the test seasons, not by raw feature ranks. With correlated modalities this measures the value added beyond the other inputs, not the total information in a modality.
blocks.zh: 讨论案文、重新分析字段和表格预测器并非每个案例共同提供。 第4.2小节中的混合方法或提供单独的编码器,然后与它们的固定长度输出相匹配。 由于编码器是固定的,每个输入的组合只需要重排递归器. Raw XGBooost 特性在13个表格变量上的重要分数,更大的图像和文本嵌入块不是模式贡献的可比度量. 连线预测器也可以扭曲特征重要性(Nicodemus2010 ) . 因此,我们评估附加的预测值,方法是使模型适应或不采用一种模式,并比较试验季节的错误,而不是按原始特征排名。 通过相关模式,衡量的是其他投入之外的附加值,而不是一种模式中的全部信息。

blocks.en: Inspired by Boussioux2022 , we pretrain a CNN encoder on ERA5 wind fields with a self-supervised objective combining next-frame embedding prediction and frame reconstruction ( subsection C.5 ), and use the trained encoder to produce 128-dimensional image embeddings. We repeat the full hybrid training process with five random seeds. In each run, we first train a CNN, then use it to extract image features for the regressor without further updating the CNN. We also explored DINOv2 ( oquab2024dinov2 ) , pretrained on natural images, but did not retain it for the reported experiments ( subsection C.4 ). For text encoding we use the pretrained Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B ( qwen3embedding ) sentence encoder without fine-tuning, retaining the first 768 dimensions of its cached output. An XGBoost gradient boosting model then fuses the raw 13 tabular SHIPS predictors, the image embeddings, and the text embeddings into a single intensity prediction.
blocks.zh: 在Boussioux2022的启发下,我们在ERA5风场上预装了CNN编码器,其自我监督的目标结合了下帧嵌入预测和帧重建(小节C.5),并使用训练有素的编码器制作128维图像嵌入. 我们用五个随机种子重复完整的混合训练过程. 在每次运行中,我们首先训练一个CNN,然后用它来提取反射器的图像特征,而不进一步更新CNN. 我们还探索了DINov2(oquab2024dinov2),在自然图像上预先训练,但没有保留用于报告的实验(C.4小节)。 对于文本编码,我们使用预先训练的Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B(qwen3embedding)句子编码器而不进行微调,保留其缓存输出的前768维. 一个XGBooost梯度增强模型然后将原始的13表型SPIS预测器,图像嵌入,文本嵌入到单一强度预测中.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Hybrid architecture. The 13 SHIPS predictors enter XGBoost directly. A CNN pretrained on ERA5 frames from the training years alone, using next-frame prediction and reconstruction, supplies fixed 128-dimensional image embeddings. The frozen Qwen3 sentence encoder supplies 768 retained text dimensions. These features are concatenated for XGBoost prediction. The separate T+I neural model uses both a CNN and a tabular MLP ( subsection 4.3 ). That MLP is not part of this hybrid encoder. Outputs give changes in V max V_{\max} and MSLP over lead h h . The shortened discussion excerpt is from Ian Discussion 19.
